targeting.source: Shipped 130 is a selected TestFunction 1 special: a live hostile within its 20 m selector with sight, and generic_free_attacks.AbilityRangeFreeAttack decides the at-rest free cast (attack 524 vs defense 1010, consistency, tactic factors; a hit only when attack exceeds defense). The retained Vector26 Deadly Shot victim trace shows a hit (34/32, 0x7a0002d6) and a deflection (43/75, 0x7a000218).
targeting.runtime: Admission checks the live selection, range and sight before cost and again at landing; the at-rest cast rolls the shared ranged contest. A deflection still plays the at-rest motion with no damage or effects; cost and reuse apply to both outcomes.
